motivation: A mere receiver foot contact can occur after a moving pass has died. Distinguish a dynamic incoming ball from a stationary re-strike, and count only a second own-foot contact with no intervening nonfoot ball contact.
clean_local_interval: from first receiver foot frame through second receiver foot frame, inclusive; no nonfoot contact by any robot in between
interpretation: At most a consumed local B6 teacher event may be identified. It is not a learned policy, a full pass-shot-goal chain, or a Fresh generalization result. No teacher labels may be promoted based on this audit.
